title: CyberAlchemy Product Thesis
problem: Intent, meaning, evidence, decisions, action, feedback, ownership, and context become disconnected across complex human-machine work.
value_proposition: CyberAlchemy helps people and machines build and evolve complex systems together through an ergonomic, feedback-controlled work loop that preserves meaning, evidence, ownership and human control.
value_mechanism: Notice the meaningful work moment, make the desired result and expected checks explicit, resolve a bounded source-digest-bound Language Context View, and select the smallest useful owner-safe action. Act inside bounded authority, observe the result, compare it with expectations, and continue, adjust, ask or stop. Preserve evidence, uncertainty, useful state and unfinished work for the next owner. Recurring weaknesses can inform separately scoped research and experiments; feedback alone does not authorize an upgrade.
boundaries: private human context remains explicit and reviewable
language consultation does not grant meaning ownership, accept a definition, choose an unresolved realization, or create authority
one realization does not prove the whole thesis
hypotheses: connected work context reduces avoidable coordination burden
meaningful work-moment recognition improves next-step fit
digest-bound Language Context Views reduce semantic drift in agent-produced Definition Packs
visible authority and proportionate governance preserve agency while enabling faster work
preserved open questions improve downstream work
counterevidence_routes: lost meaning or ownership at handoff
revision_criteria: a realization repeatedly violates a first-order principle
the approach does not create the intended outcomes
a materially simpler approach preserves the same principles and outcomes
systemic counterevidence invalidates the proposed value mechanism

revision_history.change: Typed the existing CyberAlchemy thesis as the first Product Thesis instance under CAV2-D63.
Made bounded, digest-bound Language Context consultation an application mechanism for Define without adding a new first-order principle or authority effect.
revision_history.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Language Project owner plus Invoke product or domain owner

revision_history.change: User-directed explanation of the cybernetic work loop: explicit objective and expected checks, observation, comparison, bounded adjustment, state and owner continuity. Added CYBERNETIC-WORK-LOOP.md and synchronized the record with the carrier's already-existing tenth principle, progressive inspectability and control. No new first-order principle or runtime authority is introduced.

challenge_route: Challenge product meaning through the CyberAlchemy v2 product owner; challenge evidence through the owner of the relevant Project, Research, Experiment, or outcome measure.
claim_ceiling: Committed product direction and candidate Spec artifact only; not product realization, outcome proof, market validation, publication, release, or deployment authority.
